_comment: Small, human-reviewable numerical regression baseline for the S4 Python binding.
Regenerate deliberately with gen_regression_data.py; never update automatically, because a baseline that updates itself cannot detect a regression.

Each row states its parameters, expected value, tolerance, how the expected value was obtained, and (where one exists) the independent analytic reference it agrees with.  test_regression_baseline.py verifies that the analytic reference really does produce the stored value, so a row cannot be recorded from a buggy build.
Rows with analytic_ref = null are S4-only change guards; they carry no claim of physical correctness and say so in 'origin'.
No generated or binary files are stored here.
units: lengths in lattice constants; frequency in c/a

rows.name: fresnel_bare_interface_normal_s
rows.origin: exact: R = ((n1-n2)/(n1+n2))^2 = 1/9, T = 8/9; the zero-thickness middle layer makes the S4 stack algebraically a single interface

rows.name: fresnel_bare_interface_30deg_s
rows.origin: closed-form Fresnel; the zero-thickness middle layer makes the S4 stack algebraically a single interface

rows.name: fresnel_bare_interface_30deg_p
rows.origin: closed-form Fresnel; the zero-thickness middle layer makes the S4 stack algebraically a single interface

rows.name: halfwave_film_full_transmission
rows.origin: exact half-wave condition: d = 1/(2*f*n_film) = 1, so the round-trip phase is 2*pi and the film is invisible

rows.name: quarterwave_arc_coating
rows.origin: exact quarter-wave coating: n_film = sqrt(n_sub) = 2 and d = 1/(4*f*n_film) = 0.125

rows.name: brewster_angle_p_no_reflection
rows.origin: exact: theta_B = atan(n2/n1) = 71.5650511771 deg, where the p reflectance vanishes identically

rows.name: total_internal_reflection_35deg_s
rows.origin: exact: theta = 35 deg exceeds theta_c = asin(1/2) = 30 deg, so all power is reflected

rows.name: lossy_silicon_film_absorption
rows.origin: Airy sum, the only valid reference here: the transfer-matrix formulation is ill conditioned for absorbing films and returns R + T > 1 (asserted in selftest_analytic.py).  Absorbed fraction 1 - R - T = 0.255734875.

rows.name: patterned_slab_photonic_crystal_num_basis_225
rows.origin: S4 only -- no analytic reference exists for a patterned slab. The tolerance is the measured NumBasis convergence spread over the last three refinements (1.04e-3) widened to 2e-3.  This row guards against numerical regressions; it does NOT validate the physics.
